dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged perimeters of 4-5 prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped light rings, showing a sharp gradient transition from deep charcoal/blue exterior to light grey/white interiors, particularly concentrated on the mid-dorsal flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Scattered small, solid high-intensity white/grey spots are interspersed between the larger annuli, with a higher concentration near the anterior/shoulder region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest rings on the upper mid-section form a scalene triangle with the longest side oriented along the dorsal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique interlocking topology where the boundaries of several macro-annuli merge to form a continuous, light-intensity network across the dorsal surface.
